entries.back_en: Soldier, you have reached the end of your journey.
But you must know something. I have reason to believe that the terrifying dark plague you had to face many times may originate in that room.
You shall be the first of a tide of souls [typo] to find this place, hoping to complete their 'great journey'.
Do not fear, for salvation is at hand.
Soldier, that's not the Guardian!
Beigon let a thousand warriors pass into the Gods' Ragnarok. He'd never say something like that.
Who are you to dare corrupt the established flow of souls?
Valkyries...
Though, your words ring true. I am not Beigon. But, with me, a destiny far grander than you are prepared awaits you.
entries.note: 'than you are prepared' distorts 'than you have been prepared for'; awkward/incorrect.

entries.back_en: Because of me, my species and all in the cosmos will transcend beyond mortal lives.
entries.note: 'Porque de mim' is incorrect; should be 'Por causa de mim/Graças a mim'.

entries.back_en: Without worrying about bodily decay, Yggdrasil, or those selfish Fae.
Do not resist. Once I have assimilated you, you will be saved.
It is fortunate that, even while using their power, they remain in their vessels. I will be able to extract them without destroying you.
It would be such a waste if your essence were lost to the void.
You're nothing special, but somehow you managed to get strong enough to defeat us. Our energy found a new home in you.
We don't plan to let you die to an insect like that after all you've done for us. Now you have us, like it or not.
entries.note: 'We're all you have left now' became 'Now you have us', losing the 'all you have left' nuance.

entries.back_en: Now I see why my parasites couldn't intercept you before. You turned your own body into an orb capable of retaining all that corrupt energy inside you.
Beigon?
I spent so long denying it my power... Closing off every inch of my mind...
That thing... It should not have been able to escape.
The portal... The world those mortals came from?
Soldier, that creature is wounded, but it took refuge in your world. Your civilization is in imminent danger.
I am Beigon, the Guardian.
Your mortal souls still live and, therefore, your request is valid.

But you must know that the creature that held sway over me all this time escaped to your world. Even worse, your presence here is connected to a Human infected by a parasite that traveled through one of my portals.
Arkzel...
This brave soldier confronted the parasite that created all these creatures that attacked you in the tower and freed me from its hold. But with it, your world has been damned.
Though I possess the power to travel to any corner of the universe, my penance prevents me from doing so. I will remain in this chamber until the end of time, regardless of what happens.
No, Human. This endeavour goes far beyond protecting a kingdom. It concerns your entire world and, after yours, the next, and the next, and so on. This is what the parasite does.
We will inform our kingdoms of what stalks us all and, together, we will rise against this scourge!
...Okay, maybe I had been a little worried. After all, he's the only one here doing something to change things.
entries.note: 'eu tivesse preocupado' is grammatically off; should be 'estivesse'.

entries.back_en: Hey, why are you still here? Didn't you keep up? We're going to take care of these bugs, get going!
AAAH!
I apologize for not being able to offer the welcome you deserved, soldiers.
